runtime.execution: Go goroutines/context cancellation; Fantasy dependency handles model/tool loop; per-execution shell interpreter and global background job registry; CLI/server/TUI surfaces.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns session SQLite state/background shells/task sessions/LSP; consumes model APIs and MCP services/channels.

summary: Go coding agent whose useful systems mechanisms include accepted-run cancellation identities, per-step queued steering, background shell handles, config rollback and external push channels.

inspection.scope: Entry/coordinator/Fantasy stream callbacks, native registration and file/process actions, accepted run/queue/cancel semantics, task sessions, config/hook mutation, summary retention, logs and external channel routing; read relevant fault tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Fantasy dependency scheduler internals not populated/read. Full network/LSP actions and shell exec isolation not exhaustively traced. No persistent code notebook kernel, native peer room, executable rebuild continuity, captured-state complaint or measured autoresearch established.

actions.name: view / write / edit / multiedit / glob / grep / ls
actions.output: Text/images, changes/diff metadata, matches or error
actions.lifecycle: Awaited with filetracker/history/LSP; write requires reread after observed mtime change
actions.authority: Allowed agent tools and per-action permission; metadata time check is not byte-atomic file reservation

actions.name: bash / job_output / job_kill
actions.output: Output and background ShellID; status/error, cancellation result
actions.lifecycle: Fresh shell per execution; foreground can become detached job after default 60s; process-global registry with no traced per-session handle guard
actions.authority: Prompt skip/allowlist exists but built-in command blockers remain

actions.name: agent / agentic_fetch
actions.input: Task prompt or agentic web-fetch parameters
actions.output: Independent child-session text and parent cost; no live messaging handle
actions.lifecycle: Parallel-designated prompt tool awaited; child uses configured host task agent
actions.authority: Native agent prompt has no per-call provider/model selection; question/hooks restricted in child

actions.name: fetch / web_fetch / web_search / download / sourcegraph / list_mcp_resources / read_mcp_resource
actions.surface: model tool catalog and external adapter
actions.lifecycle: Network/MCP tools use per-tool permission and discovered adapter
actions.authority: Configured allowed native/MCP tools; individual network implementations not all traced

actions.name: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_references / lsp_restart / lsp_symbols / lsp_definition / lsp_call_hierarchy / lsp_rename / lsp_replace_symbol
actions.authority: Agent AllowedTools and mutation permissions; catalog rather than every LSP implementation traced

actions.name: todos / question / crush_info / crush_logs
actions.input: TODO updates, interactive question, introspection, bounded recent-log line count
actions.output: Saved plan items/user answer/config info or redacted logs
actions.lifecycle: Session TODO persists; question operator UI only and absent from child; logs read saved file
actions.authority: Model according to agent catalog; logs caps and omission prevent original audit completeness

actions.name: Run / BeginAccepted / Cancel / Summarize / SetTools / SetModels
actions.input: Session/prompt/run id; acceptance reservation; cancellation; provider/tool update
actions.output: Live persisted assistant/tool messages and terminal RunComplete; summary id
actions.lifecycle: Same-session serial dispatch, queued steering/turn identities, latest tools per step and current model callback
actions.authority: Host config/hooks can affect steps; model does not hot-redefine compiled coordinator

actions.name: ConfigStore.ReloadFromDisk / SetConfigField(s), executable crushrc
actions.input: Disk config or field values; context for evaluation
actions.output: Candidate config or error with prior config retained
actions.lifecycle: Atomic candidate publication, runtime chosen-model overrides maintained; cancellable config program
actions.authority: Operator/config author; executable config does not establish executable agent refit

actions.name: notifications/claude/channel + discovered MCP reply tools
actions.input: Opted-in validated channel text/meta; outbound reply target/message
actions.output: New queued/session turn and tool reply
actions.lifecycle: Backend must-deliver publication/ordered routing; downstream init/dispatch errors drop logged messages
actions.authority: External MCP channel service, not native multi-agent colleague room

actions.name: PreToolUse hooks
actions.lifecycle: Top-level invocation only; errors proceed with tool call; subagents skip hook interception
actions.authority: Configured operator programs, permission preapproval scoped to tool-call id

filesystem.detail: Native files/search/edit with reread tracker and history; write uses second-resolution mtime guard, not simultaneous-writer reservation.

processes.detail: Background shell identities, output/wait/kill and foreground auto-background; global registry and detached contexts need separate lifecycle study for shared users.

code_actions.detail: Shell can execute programs and operator pre-tool/config scripts compose behavior; no native unrestricted model code-to-tools cell/kernel traced.

persistent_kernel.detail: Not established in the inspected entry, model loop, action dispatch and state paths; no universal absence claim.

standing_database.detail: Internal persisted session/message/todo/summary database; model TODO/log actions do not expose arbitrary standing research DB.

workflow_programming.detail: Config/hooks and prompt-only delegation support composition but concrete Go/Fantasy turn kernel remains fixed; native programmable workflow language not established.

multi_model.detail: Host large/small model configuration and live ModelProvider callback; task tool has prompt only and uses host-built agent, no per-call model mixing/live colleague protocol.

live_collaboration.detail: External MCP channels inject ordered text and route replies; ordinary child delegation lacks peer communication. Downstream init/dispatch errors can drop push.

concurrent_work.detail: Separate sessions, parallel-designated child agent and background job goroutines; same session dispatch serializes active vs queued calls. Fantasy tool scheduler dependency internals not inspected.

steering_interrupt.detail: Accepted sequence/cancel mark closes pre-active cancellation race; folded steering vs RunID-bearing separate turns preserve terminal events, latest step drains queue.

turn_redefinition.detail: Host hooks rewrite inputs/halt/add context; step updates tools/model. This is controlled behavior change, not model hot redefinition of turn scheduler.

compaction.detail: Automatic/manual provider summary stored as message; outgoing history selects summary tail while prior DB transcript retained.

context_repair.detail: Retained session messages and explicit summary pointer allow host recovery composition; no model-native exact restoration/lineage repair protocol traced.

original_audit.detail: Assistant/tool content persists, but retry resets partial stream text and invalid JSON arguments sanitized; diagnostic logs redacted/bounded. Not original every-attempt/wire log.

audit_query.detail: Model crush_logs reads bounded/redacted recent diagnostic file; persistent session DB program service broader but no original-audit query tool.

hot_change.detail: Config candidate reload/rollback, runtime model overrides, live tool set each step and current model callback; executable recompilation continuity not established.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Not established in the inspected entry, model loop, action dispatch and state paths; no universal absence claim.

remote_services.detail: Model-discovered MCP actions and opted-in push channel callbacks consume external services.

self_improvement.detail: Files/config/hooks can be changed as programs; no measured experiment governor/executable refit outcome traced.

complaints.detail: Not established in the inspected entry, model loop, action dispatch and state paths; no universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Skip/allowlist/autoapprove make low-approval use possible, but bash installs static command/blocker rules even when prompt requests skipped.

evaluation.detail: Specific cancellation/terminal-event/config rollback tests provide strong local fault oracles, not live provider coverage.

time_order.detail: Acceptance sequence/cancel coverage, ordered channel routing and RunID terminal events; no all-event distributed audit order.

evidence.claim: Go CLI entry, optional profiling goroutine.
Per-session dispatch/cancel lock, accepted sequence guard, busy queue, registered active request identity.
Fantasy streaming request; latest tools and queued steering prepared per step.
Model hot lookup, sanitized tool input, paired persisted results and finish callback.
Actual native catalog, MCP allow filtering and top-level-only tool hooks.
Write protects files modified since last read, asks permission and writes content.
view structured image/text range and LSP-aware file result.
Bash installs built-in blockers regardless of prompt skip; explicit background uses detached context and job identity.
Foreground cancellation kills tracked shell; threshold auto-background preserves handle.
Process-global background manager, bounded count and context/goroutine completion ownership; handles lack session scope.
Model job_output handle reads accumulated output or waits with caller context.
Model job_kill cancels global background handle and waits for completion.
agent prompt-only parallel tool builds task agent with separate child session.
Child session runs configured task agent and aggregates cost; no live peer message protocol.
Top-level pre-tool shell hooks may deny/halt/rewrite input/preapprove/add context; subagents skip hooks.
Reload builds candidate, validates hooks and preserves runtime model overrides before provider configuration.
Reload tests edited value, invalid config retention and bounded cancellation of hanging crushrc.
Summary is separate busy-checked provider run with explicit persisted summary message.
Summary stores pointer and usage then releases active request and runs queued prompt.
Outgoing compacted history reads stored summary tail and changes first summary role to user.
Internal session DB service and explicit parent/summary/todo/channel metadata.
Model logs action bounded to 50 default/100 lines with sensitive keys redacted.
Explicit channel opt-in plus must-deliver validated external notification publication.
Backend routes pushes in order across workspace goroutines; initialization/dispatch failures still drop/log push.
MCP reply target routing contract and bounded reply timeout.
Skip/allowlist/hook approval and per-session autoapprove paths before serialized permission requests.
Active and accepted cancellation test; cancel-on-entry never enqueues future work.
Gated provider test verifies RunID-bearing queued follow-up publishes own terminal completion.
Discovered external schemas mapped to mcp_<server>_<tool>.

tests.oracle: Manual active cancellation function and accepted reservation; asserts both branches covered, cancel-on-entry releases accept and never queues; broader fixture path uses scripted model, not paid provider.
Gated model holds active turn; enqueue RunID-bearing follow-up, release, assert distinct main/follow terminal events without silent folding.
Edited config value changes on reload; invalid/hanging program errors, finishes within bounded cancellation wait and preserves old notifications value.

strengths: Separate completion events for queued RunID turns.
Transactional reload candidate and canceled/invalid-program retention oracle.
Background command result identities and bounded spill metadata.
limits: Fantasy dependency scheduler internals not populated/read. Full network/LSP actions and shell exec isolation not exhaustively traced. No persistent code notebook kernel, native peer room, executable rebuild continuity, captured-state complaint or measured autoresearch established.
arconaut_questions: Would an external process service replace global unsessioned shell handles while retaining useful output/wait/cancel semantics?
Which cancellation receipts must be durable rather than process-local?
Should original failed stream fragments/unsanitized calls be kept separately from model-visible normalized transcript?
How should peer messages differ from optional MCP notifications and failure-droppable channel routing?
Can config programs and provider changes activate at an explicit turn/workflow boundary under model agency?
